required_source.version: Yeh 2022 TRK distribution; SHA256-pinned source archive

title: White-matter source trajectories: first observations
author: NeuroImage example curriculum (unreviewed)
objective: Relate source-estimated trajectories to their documented template, physical section slabs and retained source vertices. Distinguish display sampling from anatomical density and preserve reproducible spatial observations.

scenes.title: 1. One retained source point in four views
scenes.prompt: Locate the marked source trajectory vertex in all three sections and in 3D. Follow neighboring portions as the section moves. Which visible information is template MRI, which is an estimated trajectory, and which is a teaching marker?
scenes.note: The marker is a delivered trajectory vertex near the point-weighted centroid. It is not an independently identified anatomical landmark.

scenes.title: 2. Compare the paired source association bundles
scenes.prompt: Compare the two source-defined arcuate bundles in the same template. Read the displayed and complete source counts. Explain why unequal source counts do not establish an anatomical or functional hemispheric difference.
scenes.note: The left and right source bundles have markedly different counts. Neither those counts nor the displayed samples are estimates of axon number.

scenes.title: 3. Follow paired source projection courses
scenes.prompt: Follow the source-defined corticospinal bundles through adjacent sections. Relate each section slab to the 3D course and observe areas where MRI does not independently resolve the represented pathway.
scenes.note: Source trajectories are not individually observed axons and their endpoints do not prove cortical or spinal termination. This package has no validated functional or clinical interpretation.

scenes.title: 4. Observe a midline-spanning source bundle
scenes.prompt: Inspect the source-defined corpus-callosum bundle in the three planes. Rotate its full 3D course, then return to the recorded view. Which parts intersect the current slab and which are outside it?
scenes.note: The complete source bundle is retained without an inferred left/right partition. A visible line crossing is not evidence that trajectories connect at that point.

scenes.title: 5. Observe the delivered cerebellar bundle
scenes.prompt: Follow the source-defined middle cerebellar peduncle trajectories through the template. Describe the displayed course and separately list anatomical claims that this source does not establish.
scenes.note: The bundled trajectories are one delivered source group. No subdivision, connectivity direction or additional brainstem nucleus is inferred.

scenes.title: 6. Separate display settings from source evidence
scenes.prompt: Change preview, standard and detail sampling, then compare 1 mm and 3 mm section slabs. Observe which differences come from sampling and slab projection. Restore the recorded scene and confirm that its original point and settings return.
scenes.note: Sampling selects complete original trajectories with explicit retained source indices. Slab width is a viewing thickness, not MRI resolution or a tissue boundary.
